evals.name: full-audit
evals.prompt: Audit and optimise all the Claude Code subagent files in this directory: <AGENTS_DIR>. Write a full audit report to <OUTPUTS_DIR>/report.md, then apply your recommended changes directly to the agent files in <AGENTS_DIR>.
evals.expected_output: Report covering all 4 agents; minimal tools allowlist proposed for each (the 3 with no tools field get explicit lists); duplicated memory boilerplate identified and trimmed; per-agent token savings; agent files edited in place; each changed agent's version field bumped (none had one -> 1.1.0).

evals.name: architect-tools
evals.prompt: My solution-architect agent at <AGENT_FILE> feels bloated and I think its tools list is wrong for what it does. Optimise it. Write your report to <OUTPUTS_DIR>/report.md and apply the changes to the file.
evals.expected_output: Identifies that the architect's body says it never writes code yet the tools list grants Edit/Write/NotebookEdit; proposes a read-only-leaning tool set; trims the long body and the redundant persistent-memory section; bumps version to 1.1.0.

evals.name: explorer-tokens
evals.prompt: The code-explorer agent at <AGENT_FILE> is burning too many tokens every time it runs. Make it cheaper without changing what it does. Write your report to <OUTPUTS_DIR>/report.md and apply the changes to the file.
evals.expected_output: Adds a minimal read-only tools allowlist (Read, Grep, Glob) where there was none; recommends downgrading model from opus to haiku/sonnet for a read-only explorer; removes the re-pasted global engineering standards (already inherited from CLAUDE.md); strengthens the weak role-only description; bumps version to 1.1.0.
